{{Quote|You really ought to stop smoking these. They're not good for you.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
'''Ambrian cheroots''' were a type of narcotic<ref name="Wild Space" /> produced in the [[Ambria system/Legends|Ambria system]]<ref name="Planetnamia" /> that were designed to be lit and inhaled, much in the same method used to absorb the effects of different types of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Cheroots produced a pleasant, calming sensation in those who smoked them. However, the narcotic was known to cause health problems in those who indulged in it. The cheroot produced a thick, [[Color/Legends|pink]], herbal smoke. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] cook [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] smoked Ambrian cheeroots during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], although his friend, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], advised him against it.<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ambrian cheroots first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]]. ''The Clone Wars: Wild Space'' was published as a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series in [[2008]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
